newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-GUIDOLIN TO REMAIN AS VICENZA COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GUIDOLIN TO REMAIN AS VICENZA COACH.

text.p: Francesco Guidolin said on Saturday he would remain as coach of English-owned Italian serie A club Vicenza next season.
Guidolin was speaking a day after the club, who play in the European Cup Winners' Cup next season, was sold to a British investment firm at a bankruptcy auction.
Sergio Gasparin, the club's director general, also confirmed he would be staying on in his job.
The two men met Stephen Julius, managing director of investment firm Stellican, on Friday night.
Guidolin said the club's new owners were "full of enthusiasm" and added that he had been given assurances about reinforcing the squad ahead of Vicenza's European campaign.
